sentences.en: What have been the trends and what are the prospects for European transport systems?
sentences.zh: 欧洲运输系统的趋势和前景是什么？

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: A It is difficult to conceive of vigorous economic growth without an efficient transport system.
sentences.zh: A 如果没有高效的运输系统,就很难想象经济的强劲增长。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Although modern information technologies can reduce the demand for physical transport by facilitating teleworking and teleservices, the requirement for transport continues to increase.
sentences.zh: 尽管现代信息技术可以通过促进远程办公和远程服务来减少对物理运输的需求,但对运输的需求仍在不断增加。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: There are two key factors behind this trend.
sentences.zh: 这一趋势背后有两个关键因素。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: For passenger transport, the determining factor is the spectacular growth in car use.
sentences.zh: 对于客运来说,决定因素是汽车使用量的惊人增长。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The number of cars on European Union [EU] roads saw an increase of three million cars each year from 1990 to 2010, and in the next decade the EU will see a further substantial increase in its fleet.
sentences.zh: 从1990年到2010年,欧盟[EU]道路上的汽车数量每年增加300万辆,并且在未来十年中,欧盟的车队数量将进一步大幅增加。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: B As far as goods transport is concerned, growth is due to a large extent to changes in the European economy and its system of production.
sentences.zh: B 就货物运输而言,增长很大程度上归功于欧洲经济及其生产体系的变化。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In the last 20 years, as internal frontiers have been abolished, the EU has moved from a 'stock' economy to a 'flow' economy.
sentences.zh: 在过去20年里,随着内部边界的废除,欧盟已经从“存量”经济转向“流动”经济。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This phenomenon has been emphasised by the relocation of some industries, particularly those which are labour intensive, to reduce production costs, even though the production site is hundreds or even thousands of kilometres away from the final assembly plant or away from users.
sentences.zh: 一些行业,特别是劳动密集型行业的搬迁,以降低生产成本,加剧了这一现象,尽管生产地点距离总装厂或用户数百甚至数千公里。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: C The strong economic growth expected in countries which are candidates for entry to the EU will also increase transport flows, in particular road haulage traffic.
sentences.zh: C 欧盟候选国预期的强劲经济增长也将增加运输流量,特别是公路运输流量。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In 1998, some of these countries already exported more than twice their 1990 volumes and imported more than five times their 1990 volumes.
sentences.zh: 1998 年,其中一些国家的出口量已是 1990 年的两倍多,进口量是 1990 年的五倍多。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: And although many candidate countries inherited a transport system which encourages rail, the distribution between modes has tipped sharply in favour of road transport since the 1990s.
sentences.zh: 尽管许多候选国家继承了鼓励铁路的运输系统,但自 20 世纪 90 年代以来,运输方式之间的分配急剧倾斜,有利于公路运输。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Between 1990 and 1998, road haulage increased by 19.4% while during the same period rail haulage decreased by 43.5%, although - and this could benefit the enlarged EU - it is still on average at a much higher level than in existing member states.
sentences.zh: 1990 年至 1998 年间,公路运输量增长了 19.4%,而同期铁路运输量下降了 43.5%,尽管——这可能有利于扩大后的欧盟——平均水平仍远高于现有成员国。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: D However, a new imperative - sustainable development - offers an opportunity for adapting the EU's common transport policy.
sentences.zh: D 然而,新的当务之急——可持续发展——为调整欧盟共同交通政策提供了机会。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This objective, agreed by the Gothenburg European Council, has to be achieved by integrating environmental considerations into Community policies, and shifting the balance between modes of transport lies at the heart of its strategy.
sentences.zh: 哥德堡欧洲理事会同意的这一目标必须通过将环境因素纳入共同体政策来实现,而改变运输方式之间的平衡是其战略的核心。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The ambitious objective can only be fully achieved by 2020, but proposed measures are nonetheless a first essential step towards a sustainable transport system which will ideally be in place in 30 years' time, that is by 2040.
sentences.zh: 这一雄心勃勃的目标要到 2020 年才能完全实现,但拟议的措施仍然是迈向可持续交通系统的第一步,理想情况下该系统将在 30 年后（即 2040 年）建成。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: E In 1998, energy consumption in the transport sector was to blame for 28% of emissions of CO2, the leading greenhouse gas.
sentences.zh: E 1998 年,交通部门的能源消耗造成了 28% 的二氧化碳（主要温室气体）排放量。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: According to the latest estimates, if nothing is done to reverse the traffic growth trend, CO2 emissions from transport can be expected to increase by around 50% to 1,113 billion tonnes by 2020, compared with the 739 billion tonnes recorded in 1990.
sentences.zh: 根据最新估计,如果不采取措施扭转交通增长趋势,到2020年,交通运输产生的二氧化碳排放量预计将比1990年的7,390亿吨增加约50%,达到11,130亿吨。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Once again, road transport is the main culprit since it alone accounts for 84% of the CO2 emissions attributable to transport.
sentences.zh: 道路交通再次成为罪魁祸首,因为仅道路交通就占交通运输二氧化碳排放量的 84%。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Using alternative fuels and improving energy efficiency is thus both an ecological necessity and a technological challenge.
sentences.zh: 因此,使用替代燃料和提高能源效率既是生态必要性,也是技术挑战。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: F At the same time greater efforts must be made to achieve a modal shift.
sentences.zh: F 与此同时,必须付出更大的努力来实现模式转变。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Such a change cannot be achieved overnight, all the less so after over half a century of constant deterioration in favour of road.
sentences.zh: 这种改变不可能一蹴而就,更何况在半个多世纪以来道路不断恶化之后。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: This has reached such a pitch that today rail freight services are facing marginalisation, with just 8% of market share, and with international goods trains struggling along at an average speed of 18km/h.
sentences.zh: 如今,铁路货运服务正面临边缘化,市场份额仅为 8%,而国际货运列车则以 18 公里/小时的平均速度苦苦挣扎。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Three possible options have emerged.
sentences.zh: 出现了三种可能的选择。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: G The first approach would consist of focusing on road transport solely through pricing.
sentences.zh: G 第一种方法是仅通过定价来关注公路运输。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This potion would not be accompanied by complementary measures in the other modes of transport.
sentences.zh: 该药不会伴随其他运输方式的补充措施。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: In the short term it might curb the growth in road transport through the better loading ratio of the increase in the price of transport.
sentences.zh: 短期内可能会通过运输价格上涨带来的更好的装载率来抑制公路运输的增长。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: However, the lack of measures available to revitalise other modes of transport would make it impossible for more sustainable modes of transport to take up the baton.
sentences.zh: 然而,由于缺乏振兴其他交通方式的措施,更可持续的交通方式将无法接过接力棒。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: H The second approach also concentrates on road transport pricing but is accompanied by measures to increase the efficiency of the other modes [better quality of services, logistics, technology].
sentences.zh: H 第二种方法也集中于道路运输定价,但同时还采取措施提高其他模式的效率[更好的服务质量、物流、技术]。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: However, this approach does not include investment in new infrastructure, nor does it guarantee better regional cohesion.
sentences.zh: 然而,这种做法不包括对新基础设施的投资,也不能保证更好的区域凝聚力。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: It could help to achieve greater uncoupling than the first approach, but road transport would keep the lion's share of the market and continue to concentrate on saturated arteries, despite being the most polluting of the modes.
sentences.zh: 与第一种方法相比,它可以帮助实现更大的脱钩,但道路运输将保持最大的市场份额,并继续集中在饱和的动脉上,尽管它是污染最严重的运输方式。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It is therefore not enough to guarantee the necessary shift of the balance.
sentences.zh: 因此不足以保证必要的平衡转移。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: I The third approach, which is not new, comprises a series of measures ranging from pricing to revitalising alternative modes of transport and targeting investment in the trans-European network.
sentences.zh: I 第三种方法并不新鲜,包括一系列措施,包括定价、振兴替代运输方式以及针对跨欧洲网络的投资。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This integrated approach would allow the market shares of the other modes to return to their 1998 levels and thus make a shift of balance.
sentences.zh: 这种综合方法将使其他模式的市场份额恢复到1998年的水平,从而实现平衡的转变。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It is far more ambitious than it looks, bearing in mind the historical imbalance in favour of roads for the last fifty years, but would achieve a marked break in the link between road transport growth and economic growth, without placing restrictions on the mobility of people and goods.
sentences.zh: 考虑到过去五十年有利于道路的历史不平衡,该计划远比看上去雄心勃勃,但将在不限制人员和货物流动的情况下,实现道路运输增长与经济增长之间联系的显着突破。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

questions.title: Questions 14-26
instructions: Questions 14-21 : Reading Passage 2 has nine paragraphs, A-I .
Questions 22-26 : Do the following statements agree with the information given in Reading Passage 2?

items.prompt: The need for transport is growing, despite technological developments.
To reduce production costs, some industries have been moved closer to their relevant customers.
Cars are prohibitively expensive in some EU candidate countries.
The Gothenburg European Council was set up 30 years ago.
By the end of this decade, CO2 emissions from transport are predicted to reach 739 billion tonnes.
